metrics.layer_count_definition: Nondecreasing receiving-body/root support courses; not hanging-tip bottomZ or slicing layers.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.scope: Occupied8mm/4.8mm source sample andwhole-part palette projectedonto the same normalizedbody. Excludes studs,gaps,chamfers andsupports; realCGmustbeviewed separately.

front.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

side.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

painted_feature_region.interpretation: Nearest source palette labels on actual registered visible surfaces. Face pose, color regions and gaps influence this statistic; it does not declare likeness approval.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.region_definition: Tight reference-front bbox of all non-base colorcells plus5pixels; not automatic anatomical landmark detection.
descriptive_pattern_metrics.interpretation: Differences are descriptive. Morepieces are not a validated likeness percentage or mechanical completion.

front.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
front.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

three_quarter.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
three_quarter.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

limitations_ja: 倍率は実部品数で、寸法倍率ではありません。比較1xは本人不在時の暫定前提です。
完成サイズ増加で元形状の相対格子解像度を上げていますが、色境界は初期C参照で、美観改善の保証ではありません。
放射状分解は説明図。物理的に衝突せず分解できる保証ではありません。下からの順序は公称支持の検査で、保持力は未確認です。
Monaのヒゲは外付け/仮支持台ではなく同色の段付き実部品で本体の複数接点から保持する設計です。現物PLA強度は未測定、印刷時のサポート材不要とは別です。
limitations_en: The multiplier is actual physicalpiececount, not linearsize. The1xbaseline is a provisional creator assumption while the user was unavailable.
Larger fixed-pitch sampling increases relative contour resolution; colors reference initialC. More parts do not guarantee better appearance.
Radial explosion is explanatory, not collision-free physical disassembly. Bottom-up order has nominal support checks, not verified retention.

Mona's whiskers connect to multiple body-root contacts through continuous same-color stepped modules with no external or temporary assembly stands. PhysicalPLAstrength is untested; this does not mean support-free3Dprinting.

whisker_support.method: Real continuous same-color stepped beam/root modules; unchanged body envelope and 8mm root interfaces, no floor stands.

observations_ja: 実49,483部品、固定分母12,435・目標49,740との差-257で許容内。完成正面・斜め、実MP4 frame1/18/54/73/108/144と根元挿入89/90/91/92を閲覧した。
実寸679.8x551.8x598.6mm、実部品数倍率3.979333。耳、白黒の目、鼻と口、ピンクの頬、左右の実ヒゲを保持し、外付けまたは仮の組立支台は0個。見える色と占有セルを保つ根元再構成で、旧支台付きMona4案とは別の候補IDである。
格子は相対的に細かいが、額の大きな階段状の面、白目と紫の境界の不連続、口の内部や端の角張りが残る。数量が最大でも外観の最良案とは判定せず、選択を保留する。
実根元2個は231.8x223.8x14.4mmおよび231.8x207.8x14.4mm。各28断面、真の下面屋根1.6mm、native接触・挿入と全body-first順を確認した。一様密度CADの静モーメント最小marginは39.3815/30.9586mmで、後続荷重を含む83/70 prefixが1mm基準を満たす。
受け側course28→根元29、受け側29→根元30の順。実動画89では根元前、90では根元の挿入を含み、91/92では接続したヒゲが見える。受け側の段階とヒゲ先端の実底面Zを区別している。
1x1例外92個、長辺15.8mm以上49,391個。native保存・別展開再openで全49,483ID/type/color/pose/stepが一致し、保存sceneの172型の実頂点・面、放射分解の復帰、空から全数への動作も一致した。
根元はP1Sの採用した公称余白内に入る寸法だが、実印刷の適合や保持力を保証しない。PLA・インフィルの質量分布、曲げ・クリープ・手のアクセス・転倒は未検証。組立支台なしとスライサーのサポート不要は別条件であり、印刷は未承認。
observations_en: Actual49,483 pieces against the fixed12,435 denominator and target49,740, difference-257 within tolerance. Front/three-quarter stills, actual MP4 frames1/18/54/73/108/144 and root-insertion frames89/90/91/92 were inspected.

Actual size679.8x551.8x598.6mm and piece-count ratio3.979333. Ears, black/white eyes, nose/mouth, pink cheeks and actual side whiskers remain with zero external or temporary assembly aids. Root reconstruction preserves occupied source cells and visible colors; this is a distinct candidate ID from historical supported Mona4.

The relative grid is finer, but broad forehead terraces, discontinuous white-eye/purple boundaries and angular mouth details remain. The largest count is not judged to be the best-looking candidate; selection is pending.

The two native roots measure231.8x223.8x14.4mm and231.8x207.8x14.4mm. Each has28 inspected sections,1.6mm true cavity roofs, native contact/insertion evidence and a complete body-first order. Uniform-CAD-density minimum static margins are39.3815/30.9586mm across83/70 downstream-load assembly prefixes, preserving the1mm requirement.

Receiver course28 precedes root29; receiver29 precedes root30. Actual frame89 precedes the roots,90 includes insertion and91/92 show connected whiskers. Receiving-body stages are distinguished from the actual hanging-tip bottom Z.

There are92one-cell exceptions and49,391parts with a long side of at least15.8mm. Native saving and relocation match all49,483IDs/types/colors/poses/steps. The saved scene matches172native mesh types, radial return and empty-to-full animation.

Root dimensions fit the adopted nominal P1S margins, not a demonstrated print or retention test. PLA/infill mass distribution, bending, creep, hand access and tipping remain untested. No assembly stands does not imply no slicer supports. Printing is unapproved.
